newsitem.title: UK: Power de-regulation should help aluminium industry.
newsitem.headline: Power de-regulation should help aluminium industry.

text.p: Liberalisation of energy supply in Europe should prove beneficial to the aluminium industry, despite the uncertainties it will bring, Leif Hegna, Vice-President Elkem ASA Energy said.
For Europe's aluminium industry - a large user of power - liberalisation will mean more price uncertainty as buying and selling electricity becomes riskier.

"At the same time, liberalisation will tend to lower electricity prices for large users - including the large users in the aluminium industry," Hegna said at the Financial Times World Aluminium Conference.
However, the benefit of generally lower electricity prices should outweigh any disadvantage caused by increased price volatility and new risks, he said in a speech prepared for the conference.

New risks will need new contracts, although the aluminium industry has a long tradition in dealing with volatile markets and should be able to develop the tools needed to operate under new conditions.
